$doc: Each source entry declares exclusive content to pull and a conflict policy.
Sources can be external forks OR branches on your own repo.
Touchpoints (shared files the fork modified) are auto-detected from git diff.
exclusive_paths: directories/files owned entirely by this source — pulled via git checkout.
widget_entries: widget entry points — pulled like exclusive_paths but live outside the lib dir.
'prefer_source' keeps the source branch on conflicts.
